name: @eidos.space/eidos-lite-desktop
description: Independent local-first desktop client for Eidos File Spaces
author: mayneyao

scripts.build: pnpm run prepare:terminal && vite build && node scripts/verify-build-environment.mjs staging && node scripts/verify-electron-output.mjs
scripts.build:production: pnpm run prepare:terminal && vite build --mode eidos-production && node scripts/verify-build-environment.mjs production && node scripts/verify-electron-output.mjs
scripts.build:release: pnpm run prepare:terminal && vite build --mode eidos-release && node scripts/verify-build-environment.mjs production && node scripts/verify-electron-output.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run prepare:terminal && node ../../scripts/run-electron-node.mjs ../../node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.package:dir: node scripts/verify-build-environment.mjs staging && node scripts/verify-electron-output.mjs && pnpm run prepare:publish-engine && electron-builder --dir --publish never --config electron-builder.dev.json
scripts.package:production:dir: pnpm run build:production && node scripts/verify-build-environment.mjs production && node scripts/verify-electron-output.mjs && pnpm run prepare:publish-engine && electron-builder --dir --publish never --config electron-builder.json
scripts.package:release: pnpm run build:release && pnpm run prepare:publish-engine && electron-builder --publish never --config electron-builder.json
scripts.package:release:linux: pnpm run build:release && pnpm run prepare:publish-engine && electron-builder --publish never --config electron-builder.linux.json
